headline: Mozambique Concludes Comprehensive Economic Partnership Talks with UAE
summary: Mozambique concluded negotiations on a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) with the United Arab Emirates, following bilateral non-oil trade expanding 91.6% to $2.6 billion in 2025.
why: The UAE has aggressively signed CEPAs across Africa and Asia to expand trade corridors, logistics hubs, and sovereign investment partnerships.

impacts.name: Mozambique
impacts.why: Trade agreement completion lowers tariffs and expands foreign direct investment links between the UAE and Mozambique.
